# Step 2.245: The game rules asked when a league is made (lane handover)

## Builder 1: what exists today, and the plan

What exists (read 2026-11-25):

- Making a league has no web page. Our staff make one with `npm run league:make` (`scripts/make-league.mjs`, its words in `scripts/make-league.messages.mjs`): the script asks at the terminal for anything missing, `planNewLeague` (`packages/core/src/modules/leagues/rules/new-league-plan.ts`) checks the answers, and `makeLeague` (`packages/database/src/league-making/make-league.ts`) runs `leagues.create` (`packages/core/src/modules/leagues/commands/create-league.ts`) with `firstSeason`. So "the league-making screen" of this step is that script's questions.
- A first season's rules today: none are saved. `createLeague` makes the season with no rules document, and every reader (`season-view.ts` `readSeasonRules`, `games/season-rules-of.ts`) falls back to `defaultSeasonRules()`: a running clock, no mercy lead.
- "Start a new season" (step 2.130): `leagues.start_season` (`commands/start-season.ts`) makes the season and `tx.leagues.copySeasonSetup` copies the program's current season's rules, settings and divisions; with no current season nothing is copied (defaults). The page is `apps/web/src/features/season-settings/season-start-panels.tsx` (form `data-start-season-form`), its runner `run-start-season.ts`, refusals answered by `answer.ts` (`refusedBy`).
- The two rules (`packages/contracts/src/season-rules.ts`, step 2.69, read only): `clock.mode` `'stop' | 'running'` (default `'running'`, P7 §1's table); `clock.mercyLead` an integer 1 to 100 or null (default null, none). The contract refuses a mercy lead with a running clock ("A mercy rule only applies to a stop clock") and a last-minutes stop clock (`clock.stopClockLastSeconds`) with a stop clock. So a mercy rule and a running clock cannot both be the season's rule: the mercy rule is how a stop-clock game becomes a running-clock one.

Plan, in layers:

1. Below the screens: one rule in core, `rules/game-rule-answers.ts`: a list of questions (`clockMode`, `mercyLead`; builder two adds `teamFoulsReset` as one more entry), their input schema (types only, no limits), and `withGameRuleAnswers(base, answers)`, which puts the answers into a rules document and checks the whole of it with `SeasonRules` (the settings' own contract, no second copy of the limits). An answer left out keeps the base's value. `leagues.create` takes `gameRules` with `firstSeason` and saves the first season's rules from `defaultSeasonRules()` with them; `leagues.start_season` takes `gameRules` and puts them onto the copied (or default) rules, checked before anything is made. A refusal names the question it is about.
2. S-113: the screens offer no pair the settings refuse: the mercy question says it applies to a stop clock, and a mercy lead with a running clock is refused with the typed answers kept. Choosing a stop clock clears a copied last-minutes stop clock (the screens do not ask it, so the admin could not mend it); recorded as T-428.
3. The screens: the script asks the two questions (options `--clock`, `--mercy-lead`), each with its default said; the start-a-season form shows them filled with the old season's answers.
4. Tests: unit tests beside each command and the rule; the start form's runner; a browser test `game-rules-asked-test`.

## Builder 1: what exists now, and what is left

Built (items 1 to 3 of 5): `rules/game-rule-answers.ts` (questions `clockMode`, `mercyLead`; checked by `SeasonRules`, T-428); `leagues.create` takes `firstSeason.gameRules` and saves the first season's rules; `leagues.start_season` takes `gameRules` onto the copied (or starting) rules, refused before anything is made. `planNewLeague` and `npm run league:make` ask `--clock` and `--mercy-lead` (defaults running, none; the mercy question is skipped under a running clock); `makeLeague` passes them on. The start-a-season form (`season-start-panels.tsx`) asks both, filled from the copied season (`getSeason` of the current one), marks `data-game-rules`, `data-game-rule="clockMode"` and `data-game-rule="mercyLead"`. Words in `admin-settings.ts` and `error.ts` (English is the only language file) and `scripts/make-league.messages.mjs`. Decisions pending: S-118 (decided for you), T-428. No migration. Spec: P7 §5 S-118 line.

S-113: no screen offers a mercy lead with a running clock as a choice: the script does not ask it, and the form's help says "only with a stop clock"; a mercy lead typed beside a running clock is refused by the contract (`game-rule-refused`).

Run and passed: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run check`, vitest of `packages/core/src/modules/leagues` (392), `apps/web/src/features/season-settings` (57), `packages/site` (93), `make-league.test.ts` and `make-league-script.test.ts`, `tests/pending-decisions.test.mjs`.
